en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard view over a large lake bordered by forested hills and open meadows, with a village spread along the shore. A winding road follows the lake edge through trees. The surrounding mountains are mostly treeless on top with darker forest bands. At the top margin in red print are place names indicating the scene is of Titisee in the Black Forest and the nearby mountain Hochfirst with its elevation.
